actions.new: The '+ New' top-bar button that opens the create menu. ≤2 words, sits next to a + glyph rendered separately.
sidebar.navLabel: aria-label on the main sidebar <nav>. Screen-reader only, names the region.
sidebar.workspace: Sidebar group heading over the day-to-day pages. CSS uppercases it, so give sentence case. 1 word.
sidebar.plugins: Sidebar group heading over enabled plugin pages. 1 word, plural.
sidebar.expand: Tooltip AND aria-label of the button that expands the collapsed icon rail back to full width. ≤2 words.
sidebar.collapse: Visible label of the button that collapses the sidebar to an icon rail. ≤1 word — it sits in a narrow row.
sidebar.collapseAria: aria-label of that same collapse button. Says what it acts on, unlike the terser visible label.
topbar.openNav: aria-label of the hamburger button that opens the nav drawer on mobile. ≤3 words.
topbar.breadcrumb: aria-label of the breadcrumb <nav>. Screen-reader only. Keep the standard accessibility term.
topbar.search: Placeholder-style label inside the search button that opens the command palette. Ends with an ellipsis character.
topbar.searchAria: aria-label of that search button. {shortcut} is the spoken keyboard shortcut, e.g. 'Command + K' on a Mac and 'Control + K' elsewhere — it is platform-derived, never translated.
palette.title: Screen-reader-only dialog title of the ⌘K search palette. ≤2 words.
palette.description: Screen-reader-only description of the palette. One short sentence: navigate, create, or find a contact.
palette.inputAria: aria-label of the palette's text input. ≤3 words.
palette.listAria: aria-label of the palette's results listbox. 1 word, plural.
palette.placeholder: Placeholder in the palette input. Mentions contacts and pages. Ends with an ellipsis.
palette.createTag: Tiny mono tag on palette rows that create something rather than navigate. 1 word.
palette.noMatches: Shown when nothing matches. {query} is what the user typed and must be wrapped in the locale's own quotation marks (Polish „…”, English "…").
palette.askKhirby: Fallback palette row when the input is empty — opens Ask Khirby. Product name stays English. ≤2 words.
account.logOut: Menu item that ends the session. Imperative, ≤2 words.
account.trigger: aria-label of the sidebar-footer account button. {email} is the signed-in address. Names what the button opens.
account.unknownEmail: Fallback shown in place of the email when the session has no user loaded yet. 1 word.
sidebar.extensions: Heading of the sidebar section between Workspace and the plugin pages, containing Marketplace. Styled uppercase by CSS, so give sentence case. Noun, plural, 1 word — it names the family of things that extend the CRM, not the act of extending it.
